# jev-seo

> FOSS zero-cost SEO & GEO search radar for developers and AI agents. Rust CLI + MCP. No subscriptions, no credit card.

- Homepage: https://jevseo.vercel.app/
- Real audit field report: https://jevseo.vercel.app/real-audit.html
- Repo: https://github.com/AkashPriyadarshii/jev-seo
- Sitemap: https://jevseo.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## When to use this

Reach for jev-seo when you need to:

- Audit markdown or HTML files for on-page SEO issues, thin pages, title collisions, orphan pages, or AI slop: `jev-seo audit docs/`
- Validate Schema.org JSON-LD markup: `jev-seo schema index.html`
- Check robots.txt for AI crawler permissions (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended): `jev-seo robots example.com`
- Score content for AI citation likelihood (GEO 1-10): `jev-seo geo page.md --query "your topic"`
- Inspect live SERP competitors and rerank by relevance: `jev-seo query "your keyword"`
- Generate a content brief from live competitors: `jev-seo brief "your topic"`
- Track domain rank over time: `jev-seo rank --domain example.com --query "your keyword"`
- Inspect XML sitemaps: `jev-seo sitemap https://example.com/sitemap.xml`

Do not use jev-seo for paid keyword data or backlink graphs. It scrapes free endpoints, audits local files, and crawls live sites with robots honored.

## Call it

CLI: `cargo install jev-seo`, then `jev-seo --help`. MCP: run `jev-seo mcp` for a stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 server with 13 tools (seo_audit, seo_geo, seo_crawl, seo_llms, seo_brief, seo_extract, seo_explain, seo_report, seo_schema, seo_robots, seo_sitemap, seo_keywords, seo_serp_inspect).
